intro: Israeli culture blends Jewish traditions from around the world with Middle Eastern food, music and modern Hebrew art.

chapters.title: Festivals
text: Jewish holidays like Passover, Yom Kippur and Hanukkah shape the calendar. Christians celebrate in Nazareth and Bethlehem, and Muslims in Jerusalem and Arab towns.

chapters.title: Arts and food
text: Hebrew writers like Amos Oz and David Grossman are read worldwide, and Israeli TV series like Fauda have been remade abroad. Falafel, hummus, shakshuka and sabich are everyday foods shared with the wider region.

keyTerms.meaning: The eight-day Jewish festival of lights.
